title: Malaysian Satay with Pineapple Salsa
description: A flavorful and spicy Malaysian-inspired satay dish served with a sweet and tangy pineapple salsa. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, ginger, lime juice, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Blend until smooth.
Thread chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the chicken with the coconut milk mixture, making sure they are evenly coated.
Grill the satay over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine pineapple, red onion, red bell pepper, and jalapeño in a bowl.
Stir in lime juice and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the grilled satay with the pineapple salsa on the side.
